verifiedExcerpts: The weak pull-up and pull-down resistors are disabled
Read access to the input data register gets the value 0
paraphrase: In Analog mode the output buffer and Schmitt-trigger digital input are inactive. The input logic is fixed low, internal pulls are off, and the analog peripheral path remains connected.
implementationBoundary: Retain configured/generated Pull selections, but do not create internal resistors in Analog mode. Digital reads return zero without clamping the physical node voltage or the ADC measurement.
